data.name: Tharun
data.gender_notes: Tharun is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Tharun is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tharunam' which means 'Sun'. This name is also associated with the radiant and young sun. It signifies vitality, vision, and wisdom. The name Tharun carries the meaning “Sun, Radiant, Young” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Telugu, Kannada. Parents who choose Tharun usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, radiant, young and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Tharun holds spiritual significance in Hinduism. It is believed that the name Tharun invokes the blessings of the Sun God, who is considered the source of all life and energy. This name is also believed to bring good fortune and prosperity to the bearer.
data.etymology: Tharun belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun, Radiant, Young.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tharun total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: Tharun is a Hindu name and holds a significant place in Hindu mythology and culture. The name Tharun is associated with the sun god, Surya, who is an integral part of Hinduism. Surya is known for bringing light, energy, and life to the world. The name Tharun embodies these qualities, symbolizing power, strength, and vitality. Tharun is a name that radiates positivity and energy, instilling a sense of confidence and determination in individuals who bear it.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Tharun represents the divine light of the sun god, Surya. It is believed that the name Tharun connects the individual to the radiant energy of the sun, imbuing them with the qualities of wisdom, vision, and strength. Tharun is also associated with the idea of growth and evolution, as the sun represents the source of all life and energy. In Hinduism, the sun is also believed to be the source of consciousness and the manifestation of the divine in the material world. Therefore, the name Tharun is not only a reminder of the physical radiance and strength of the sun but also a symbol of the spiritual light and wisdom that lies within each individual.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Tharun signifies the awakened divine warrior within, who is fearless in the face of challenges and dedicated to dharma. It embodies the spirit of courage, determination, and righteousness.
